_doc: Phần Vũ Đường signature items (rules-proposals R7; design/items record). Prefix pvd-. pvd-xich-ha-ky is the item record for the legendary banner xich_ha_ky (world_history legendary items; Phượng Minh's Hall of Spoils keeps its empty hook). Unpriced proposals; modifier sizes follow the fire and body catalogues' grade 3-4 items. The head also wears the catalogue armour body-vajra-hide-armour (unchanged).

items.name: Red Cloud Banner (Xích Hà Kỳ)

effects.name: Red Cloud Rising (Xích Hà Thăng)
effects.rule: While the banner is planted, allies within its cloud gain 1 Fire stack of fury every 3 s, each adding attack and each burning its holder for a little health each second; the first ally to fall in the cloud each fight rises once at a fifth of their health.

items.lore: Xích Thành Môn's war banner, woven in 260 from fire-silk reeled at the vents (C068). Phượng Minh took it in 590 (C119) and hung it in the Hall of Spoils. In 1020 the founder lent it to the young Hùng Phần Vũ (C177). Its red has faded to the colour of a cooling coal. The palace treasurer Vưu Cẩm Thư has asked for it back three times. Hùng carries it into the vent at every first sitting, so that the new disciple sits under it.
items.build_use: A war banner for the hall's levy: Fire fury on allies and one rising.

items.name: Cinder Knuckle (Tẫn Quyền Hoàn)
items.lore: A heavy ring of red Đan Thạch stone set in iron, worn on the fist. Tào Tẫn Kiên ground it himself from a stone he carried out of the vent the day Hùng made him an elder, and it has been in more fights than he has admitted to.
items.build_use: The first elder's brawling ring: physical blows, a body shield, a little Fire.

items.name: Hide Tempered in Moving Fire (Lưu Hỏa Bì Giáp)
items.lore: A hide jerkin he wore into the vent the day the palace founder watched him stand in moving fire for an hour (C177). It came out black and has never burned since.
items.build_use: Stands in the lava: health, body shield and Fire resistance.

items.name: Cradle Feather (Hồng Vũ Ngọc Bội)
items.lore: The red feather the docks say fell on his cradle in Ngũ Thải Thành (A309), set in a cage of vent iron.
items.build_use: The heat the body gives back: fist and Fire damage.

items.name: Sitting-Stone Mail (Tọa Thạch Giáp)
items.lore: Plates of the red vent stone the sitters sit on, sewn onto leather. Every disciple he has brought out of the vent has touched it for luck.
items.build_use: The shield that lets you burn yourself out on him.

items.name: Weiqi-Board Shield (Kỳ Bàn Thuẫn)
items.lore: A square shield of stone cut with nineteen lines each way, the board he plays the palace's clerks on. He has never lost a game on it at the Fire Court.

sets.name: Standing in the Fire (Lập Hỏa Tam Bảo)

bonuses.effect: Burn and Get Back Up (Phần Nhi Khởi): each time your body shield breaks, you regain 15 % of your health, and your next fist strike deals extra Fire damage equal to the shield's value. Once a fight, while you wear the Xích Hà Kỳ, a blow that would knock you out leaves you standing at a third of your health.

sets.story: Two pieces are his own, from the day in 1020 he stood in the vent. The third is the Xích Hà Kỳ, which is not his: Phượng Minh lent it out of the Hall of Spoils, and Xích Thành wove it. The set is whole only while the palace's loan stands.

sets.name: Master of the Sittings (Tọa Sư Tam Bảo)

bonuses.effect: Let You Burn Out (Đãi Tẫn): each hit you block or take on your body shield adds one heat to your store. At ten heat your next fist strike releases it all as Fire damage, and for 3 s every foe who strikes you takes a Burn batch.

sets.story: The ring from the day he became an elder, the mail of the sitting stones and the board shield from the Fire Court's steps. He holds all three, and the hall reads the board as a sign of where his friends are.
